sprint10_key_lesson: KEYWORD DOMAINS ARE NOT SEO DOMAINS. All 5 domains verified in this sprint had zero organic presence. Their value was entirely based on keyword brand potential, not inheritable SEO equity. The Sprint 9 Deep Verification Protocol correctly identifies this distinction: DataForSEO showing zero keywords = no SEO value, regardless of how good the keyword combination sounds. Brand value is real but worth significantly less than SEO equity. Always verify before assigning T1 priority or premium bids to keyword-play domains.
